title: Rejections teach extraction; rejected names never collect links
description: Rejected stays rejected and machines never change an existing concept, but normalize_name and slug differ, so 'GPT 4' can miss rejected 'GPT-4' and links still get written to a rejected lineage (publish_run.py:341-364). Use one identity for both. Rejected names feed the candidate filter, so a person's or AI review's rejection is learned from. First step of the self-learning loop.
